description: Create or update a sequence from a definition document keyed by your own step keys, as returned by get_sequence_definition. Steps are matched by key: new keys are added, changed steps are updated in place, and steps missing from the document are removed, with any contacts waiting on them moved to the step that follows (or completed when nothing follows). Connections replace the stored graph, which must keep one trigger, reach an end step and contain no cycles. Settings fields you omit keep their stored values. A push never turns a sequence on or off or pauses it: new sequences start as drafts with managedBy code, which makes their steps read-only in the dashboard while on/off, pause and test sends stay available. Use dryRun true to see the changes (sequence fields, added/changed/removed steps with waiting contact counts, connection changes) without saving. Changing an active sequence needs confirmLiveChange true. A/B test steps keep their stored settings and cannot be created or removed here; inbound webhook triggers keep their event name. The dashboard lock does not cover API/MCP writes: changes made with update_sequence are replaced by the next push. To adopt an existing sequence that has no key, pull it with sequenceId, set key, and push.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

confirmLiveChange.description: Required to change an active sequence: confirms the change can affect current and future recipients.

definition.description: The definition, in the readable format (name, trigger, settings?, steps) as get_sequence_definition returns it, or the explicit format (steps with type/config plus connections). Email steps take subject, previewText, name and html or blocks, or template: <email id> to copy a saved template (written fields override it). Every step needs a lasting key. A branch needs else (use [] to continue straight on).

dryRun.description: Return the changes without saving them. Defaults to false.

key.description: Your own key for the sequence: 1-128 characters of letters, digits, '_', '-' or '.', starting with a letter or digit.

name: push_sequence_definition

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `push_sequence_definition` MCP tool.

changes.description: Changed sequence fields, added/changed/removed steps (with waiting contact counts) and added/removed connections.

created.description: Whether the push created a new sequence.

dryRun.description: Whether the changes were only returned, not saved.

hasChanges.description: Whether the document differs from what is stored.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequence.description: The sequence: id, key, name, status and managedBy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Fields that were ignored or need attention.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
